title: How OpenAI o3 reasoning model changes software development forever

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How might OpenAI's o3 reasoning model redefine the core of software development in the next decade?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: o3 enables self-correcting code generation, real-time debugging, and adaptive UIs, making complex systems more maintainable and scalable.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But such power risks widening the gap between those who control these tools and those who don’t, potentially centralizing innovation and decision-making.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Open-source frameworks and community-driven tooling are emerging to democratize access and ensure transparency in model training and deployment.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a future where developers collaborate globally in real time, solving problems with AI as a co-creator, not just a tool.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future of software lies not in automation alone, but in the ethical and inclusive integration of reasoning models like o3.
